description: This file defines React components for setting up application-wide providers, including an error boundary, QueryClientProvider, and CompanyProvider for context management.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: React component that catches JavaScript errors anywhere in its child component tree, logs those errors, and displays a fallback UI.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromError
methods.description: Static lifecycle method that updates state to indicate an error has occurred when an error is caught.

methods.name: componentDidCatch
methods.description: Lifecycle method for performing side-effects such as logging when an error has been caught.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders fallback UI if an error is present, otherwise renders children components.

methods.name: AppProviders
methods.description: Functional component that composes the error boundary and context providers to wrap the application's children components.
